compiled_state.title: [preplanning + completion-verifier]: epic with cross-skill non-structured signals -> integration defects survive epic-close (no contract artifact, no integration story, no orchestrator-entry dogfood)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 61759d31448163d223cbfb45ca8aeb7833fd1f97
* **Affected skills/agents:** /dso:brainstorm, /dso:preplanning, /dso:sprint, /dso:implementation-plan, dso:completion-verifier, dso:story-decomposer
* **Triggering epic:** f360-3a5b-b8f3-4f86 (Gov-copy sub-agent for empathetic, plain-language UI copy) — closed with P1=PASS verifier; three integration defects discovered post-merge-prep.

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (internal-dogfood: user asked "how do we indicate stories that require copy editing?" and found the answer was structurally broken)

#### Expected Behavior

When /dso:preplanning + /dso:sprint produce an epic whose stories communicate via cross-skill signals (tags, title patterns, file-path conventions, status strings):

1. **(Gap A) Contract artifact exists for the cross-skill interface.** Any inter-skill signal that is NOT a structured payload (no schema, no JSON envelope — just a tag string, title prefix, status token, file-path convention) MUST have a one-paragraph constants doc at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/<signal>.md, listed in the producer's File Impact AND every consumer's File Impact. /dso:preplanning's story-decomposer must surface a constants doc as an explicit story DD when ≥2 stories share a non-structured signal. Today this is not enforced.

2. **(Gap B) Integration stories are required when cross-story dependencies exceed a threshold.** Stories partitioned by artifact (build the agent / build the schema / build the post-processor / build the dispatcher) without a sibling integration story (an orchestrator-level entry-point that exercises producer→consumer→artifact end-to-end on a fixture) ship as a collection of working leaves that don't compose. /dso:preplanning red-team scrutiny mentions "wiring risk" as a soft consideration but does not require an integration story when the dependency-graph fan-in across stories exceeds N (suggested: 2).

3. **(Q2) Dogfood story SCs must exercise the orchestrator-level entry point, not just the leaf component.** When an epic introduces a new sub-agent dispatch path or new orchestrator routing, the dogfood story DD MUST feed a fixture input through the orchestrator-level entry point (/dso:brainstorm → /dso:preplanning → /dso:sprint against a fixture epic ticket) and assert the new dispatch path activated. Asserting that the leaf component behaves correctly in isolation is insufficient.

#### Actual Behavior

Three concrete defects survived to epic-verifier P1=PASS on f360-3a5b-b8f3-4f86:

a) **Tag mismatch.** dso:story-decomposer wrote stories tagged `copy-story`. /dso:sprint Phase E Copy Story Dispatch detected `copy:needed`. No contract artifact pinned the canonical value.

b) **Title-prefix mismatch.** dso:story-decomposer wrote story titles prefixed `'Apply gov-copy to '`. /dso:sprint Phase E detected `'Generate UI copy'`. Same root cause — no contract artifact.

c) **No /dso:implementation-plan bypass.** A copy story routed through /dso:implementation-plan would have been decomposed into ordinary RED/GREEN tasks, silently bypassing dso:gov-copy-writer dispatch entirely. The integration was not a story output.

The completion-verifier P1=PASS verdict was a structural false positive: each individual artifact existed; the integration between them was broken. No story DD asserted producer/consumer constants matched. No story DD asserted the orchestrator-entry path activated the new dispatch.

The dogfood story (5003-75a8-ccfc-4773) DID exist and DID exit 0 — but only because it tested the deterministic post-processor in isolation on a hand-crafted before/after pair, never feeding a fixture epic through /dso:brainstorm → /dso:preplanning → /dso:sprint.

### 3. Action History

* 2026-05-25 — User asked "how do we indicate stories that require copy editing?" on the closed epic.
* 2026-05-25 — Grep across producer (story-decomposer.md) and consumers (sprint/SKILL.md, implementation-plan/SKILL.md) surfaced the three mismatches.
* 2026-05-25 — Fix landed inline on the merge branch (commit 61759d3144 — "fix(copy-story-integration): align producer/consumer constants + impl-plan bypass") with 10-assertion integration test pinning constants across all three files.

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

The fix for f360-3a5b resolves the SYMPTOMS (specific tag/title/bypass mismatches). It does NOT address the PROCESS that allowed the symptoms to ship.

Four concrete process changes are required:

**(A) /dso:preplanning — Constants-doc-required gate.** When dso:story-decomposer detects ≥2 stories that will exchange a non-structured signal (tag name, title-pattern detection, status token, file-path convention), require a contract artifact story whose DD includes "a one-paragraph constants doc at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/<signal>.md exists; producer + consumer File Impact sections both reference it."

**(B) /dso:preplanning — Integration story required for fan-in epics.** When the dependency graph across stories has any node with fan-in ≥ 2 (story-decomposer's existing dependency analysis already computes this), require an integration story whose DDs include an end-to-end fixture exercising producer→consumer→artifact through the orchestrator-level entry point.

**(C) dso:completion-verifier — Consumer smoke tests required for producer tickets.** The verifier output schema already declares a `consumer_smoke_tests` field but never populates it. When verifying a producer ticket (story that writes a signal consumed by another story in the same epic), the verifier MUST execute a consumer-side detection smoke test using the producer's actual emitted values, not the producer's claimed values. Today the verifier reads producer-side artifacts and asserts patterns exist; it never executes consumer-side detection logic. A 5-line bash test that fed the producer's actual tag to the consumer's grep would have caught defects (a) and (b) at story-level verification.

**(D) /dso:brainstorm — Orchestrator-entry dogfood SC pattern.** When an epic introduces a new sub-agent dispatch path or orchestrator routing, the dogfood/closing-session SC MUST require an orchestrator-entry fixture test (input enters at /dso:brainstorm or /dso:preplanning, output asserts the new dispatch path activated). Leaf-component dogfooding is insufficient.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* /dso:preplanning — story-decomposer needs a "cross-skill constants signal" detector + an "integration story required when fan-in ≥ 2" rule
* /dso:sprint — no change to sprint itself; sprint correctly dispatches what preplanning produces
* /dso:implementation-plan — no further change beyond the bypass already added in commit 61759d3144
* dso:completion-verifier — populate consumer_smoke_tests when verifying a producer ticket; add "execute consumer-side detection" rule
* /dso:brainstorm — add "orchestrator-entry dogfood SC pattern" to the SC template for epics introducing new sub-agent dispatch paths or orchestrator routing

### 6. Logs

```
$ grep -E 'copy-story|copy:needed' plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
# Pre-fix: producer used 'copy-story', consumer used 'copy:needed' — NO MATCH
# Post-fix (commit 61759d3144): both use 'copy-story'

$ bash plugins/dso/tests/test-copy-story-integration.sh
TOTAL: 10 passed, 0 failed
# Integration test now pins constants; would fail loudly if either side renames
# without the other.
```

#### Acceptance Criteria for closing this bug

- [ ] /dso:preplanning story-decomposer detects ≥2 stories sharing a non-structured signal AND requires a constants-doc story.
- [ ] /dso:preplanning red-team / SC-coverage gate requires an integration story when story-graph fan-in ≥ 2.
- [ ] dso:completion-verifier executes consumer-side detection on producer tickets and populates `consumer_smoke_tests`.
- [ ] /dso:brainstorm SC template requires an orchestrator-entry dogfood SC for epics introducing new dispatch paths.
- [ ] Each of A/B/C/D has its own test asserting the gate fires on a fixture epic that would have shipped the f360-3a5b defects.
